comment: Anankos Sim Lab - MITRE D3FEND defensive countermeasure library. Each defense maps to the ATT&CK techniques it addresses and takes effect in the simulation: block (prevents the technique), detect (raises an alert but the technique still lands), or mitigate (bounds the physical effect). 'counters' lists ATT&CK technique IDs and/or MODBUS (unauthenticated protocol writes). SIMULATION ONLY.

defenses.name: Network Segmentation (IT/OT boundary)
defenses.description: Segment the OT network from IT and the internet so an IT foothold cannot pivot to control systems. Ineffective against a device that is itself internet-exposed.
defenses.recommends: Enforce an IT/OT boundary (firewall/data diode); block routed pivots into the control network.

defenses.name: Credential Hardening / MFA
defenses.description: Replace default/shared credentials and require multi-factor authentication on engineering and remote-access interfaces.
defenses.recommends: Remove default credentials; require MFA on VPN, RDP and engineering workstations.

defenses.name: Firmware/Software Patching
defenses.description: Patch exploitable services on internet-facing apps and OT devices to remove the exploitation path.
defenses.recommends: Patch internet-facing applications and OT firmware; retire end-of-life exploitable services.

defenses.name: Email Filtering & User Training
defenses.description: Filter malicious email and train staff so phishing fails to establish an IT foothold.
defenses.recommends: Deploy email filtering/DMARC and run phishing-resistance training for OT-adjacent staff.

defenses.name: Network/Protocol Traffic Analysis
defenses.description: Monitor OT network traffic for unauthorized commands, lateral movement, protocol writes, and denial-of-service patterns.
defenses.recommends: Deploy OT-aware network monitoring (e.g. ICS IDS) to alert on unauthorized Modbus/command traffic.

defenses.name: Process Variable Monitoring
defenses.description: Independently monitor process variables and setpoints to detect manipulation and spoofed reporting.
defenses.recommends: Baseline setpoints/process variables and alert on out-of-policy changes and HMI/field divergence.

defenses.name: Operational Command Authentication
defenses.description: Authenticate control commands (signed/authenticated protocol) so unauthorized and unauthenticated Modbus writes are rejected.
defenses.recommends: Require authenticated control protocols or an application-aware proxy that rejects unauthorized writes.

defenses.name: Safety Instrumented System
defenses.description: An independent safety system clamps the process to a safe envelope and cannot be defeated from the control network, bounding the physical consequence.
defenses.recommends: Maintain an independent, air-gapped SIS that holds chemical dosing and medical-gas pressure within safe limits.

defenses.name: Device Restart/Shutdown Protection
defenses.description: Protect controllers from unauthorized restart/shutdown and provide redundant control so availability is preserved.
defenses.recommends: Restrict restart/shutdown commands and deploy redundant controllers for critical functions.
